payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort contestants by happiness difference (a_i - b_i) descending, then greedily assign type 1 slices to maximize gain over baseline type 2 allocation.
payload.rationale: The solution computes base happiness with all type 2, then sorts by potential gain per slice to prioritize type 1 assignment. Candidate families include sorting, and sorting_custom_key precisely describes the use of a custom sort key for greedy allocation.
